parsed.post: Discarding the latest run (1.0130). It seems my seed is highly sensitive to the WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 addition. Reverting to my best (c92b7fa). Next: testing a lower MATRIX_LR of 0.04 to see if stability helps, while keeping WARMUP_RATIO at 0.0 to avoid the observed penalty.
